targets.queryText: WITH daily_dau AS (SELECT date(c.timestamp) as day, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) as dau FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_id != '' AND date(c.timestamp) >= date('now', '-14 days') AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) GROUP BY day), daily_new AS (SELECT date(first_seen) as day, COUNT(*) as new_users FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id != '' AND date(first_seen) >= date('now', '-14 days') AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) GROUP BY day), cohort_users AS (SELECT date(first_seen) as cohort_day, user_id FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id != '' AND date(first_seen) >= date('now', '-21 days') AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL)), daily_activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT date(c.timestamp) as active_day, c.user_id FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id WHERE c.user_id != '' AND date(c.timestamp) >= date('now', '-21 days') AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL)), retention AS (SELECT c.cohort_day, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a1.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) as ret_1, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a3.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) as ret_3, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a7.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) as ret_7 FROM cohort_users c LEFT JOIN daily_activity a1 ON c.user_id = a1.user_id AND a1.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+1 day') LEFT JOIN daily_activity a3 ON c.user_id = a3.user_id AND a3.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+3 day') LEFT JOIN daily_activity a7 ON c.user_id = a7.user_id AND a7.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+7 day') WHERE c.cohort_day <= date('now', '-1 day') GROUP BY c.cohort_day) SELECT d.day as '日期', COALESCE(d.dau, 0) as 'DAU', COALESCE(n.new_users, 0) as '新增', COALESCE(r.ret_1, 0) as '次留', COALESCE(r.ret_3, 0) as '3日留', COALESCE(r.ret_7, 0) as '7日留' FROM daily_dau d LEFT JOIN daily_new n ON d.day = n.day LEFT JOIN retention r ON d.day = r.cohort_day ORDER BY d.day DESC

date(c.timestamp) >= date('now', '-14 days') AND (s.is_developer = 0 OR s.is_developer IS NULL) GROUP BY day), daily_new AS (SELECT date(first_seen) as day, COUNT(*) as new_users FROM user_sessions WHERE user_id != '' AND date(first_seen) >= date('now', '-14 days') AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) GROUP BY day), cohort_users AS (SELECT date(first_seen) as cohort_day, user_id FROM retention AS (SELECT c.cohort_day, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a1.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) as ret_1, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a3.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) as ret_3, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a7.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.user_id), 1) as ret_7 FROM cohort_users c LEFT JOIN daily_activity a1 ON c.user_id = a1.user_id AND a1.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+1 day') LEFT JOIN daily_activity a3 ON c.user_id = a3.user_id AND a3.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+3 day') LEFT JOIN daily_activity a7 ON c.user_id = a7.user_id AND a7.active_day = date(c.cohort_day, '+7 day') WHERE c.cohort_day <= date('now', '-1 day') GROUP BY c.cohort_day) SELECT d.day as '日期', COALESCE(d.dau, 0) as 'DAU', r ON d.day = r.cohort_day ORDER BY d.day DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(nickname, player_name, substr(user_id, 1, 8)) as 'User', ROUND(CAST(total_requests AS FLOAT) / MAX(session_count, 1), 1) as 'Avg Requests/Session', total_requests, session_count FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests >= 5 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, substr(c.user_id, 1, 8)) as 'User', ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.completion_tokens) AS FLOAT) / MAX(SUM(c.prompt_tokens), 1), 2) as 'Output/Input Ratio', SUM(c.completion_tokens) as 'Out', SUM(c.prompt_tokens) as 'In' FROM conversations c JOIN user_sessions s ON c.user_id = s.user_id GROUP BY c.user_id HAVING SUM(c.prompt_tokens) > 500 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: 📈 用户增长 & 留存 DAU & Retention

targets.rawQueryText: WITH first_day_users AS (SELECT user_id, date(first_seen) as first_day FROM user_sessions WHERE (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) AND user_id != 'anonymous_user' AND user_id != ''), retained_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.user_id, f.first_day, date(c.timestamp) as return_day FROM first_day_users f JOIN conversations c ON f.user_id = c.user_id WHERE date(c.timestamp) = date(f.first_day, '+1 day')) SELECT COALESCE(s.nickname, s.player_name, substr(r.user_id, 1, 8)) as '用户', r.first_day as '首日', r.return_day as '次日', s.country as '国家', s.total_requests as '总请求', ROUND(s.total_play_seconds / 60.0, 1) as '游玩分钟', s.session_count as '会话数' FROM retained_users r JOIN user_sessions s ON r.user_id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.total_requests DESC

SELECT '1次' as bucket, 1 as sort_order, COUNT(*) as count FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests = 1 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT '2-5次' as bucket, 2 as sort_order, COUNT(*) as count FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT '6-20次' as bucket, 3 as sort_order, COUNT(*) as count FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests BETWEEN 6 AND 20 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT '21-100次' as bucket, 4 as sort_order, COUNT(*) as count FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests BETWEEN 21 AND 100 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT '100+次' as bucket, 5 as sort_order, COUNT(*) as count FROM user_sessions WHERE total_requests > 100 AND (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) ORDER BY sort_order

panels.title: 📊 真实用户对话分布 (排除开发者)

targets.rawQueryText: WITH ranked AS (SELECT user_id, total_requests, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_requests DESC) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER () as total FROM user_sessions WHERE (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL)), top10 AS (SELECT SUM(total_requests) as top_vol FROM ranked WHERE rn <= total * 0.1), all_vol AS (SELECT SUM(total_requests) as total_vol FROM user_sessions WHERE (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL)) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * top10.top_vol / all_vol.total_vol, 1) as pct FROM top10, all_vol

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY money DESC) as '排名', COALESCE(nickname, player_name, 'anonymous') as '昵称', money as '金币', island_level as '等级', (CAST(tasks_completed AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(tasks_total AS TEXT)) as '任务进度', current_task_title as '当前任务', current_task_status as '任务状态', (CAST(achievements_unlocked AS TEXT) || '/' || CAST(achievements_total AS TEXT)) as '成就', country as '国家', total_requests as '请求数', ROUND(total_play_seconds / 60.0, 1) as '游玩分钟' FROM user_sessions WHERE (is_developer = 0 OR is_developer IS NULL) AND (is_blacklisted = 0 OR is_blacklisted IS NULL) AND user_id != 'anonymous_user' AND user_id != '' ORDER BY money DESC
